title: capabilities.csv (one object per CSV row; every CSV field is text, integer columns parse as integers)

state.description: reported-in-docs: the tool lists the capability in its documentation or public API; not run. checked-agrees: run, and values agree with an independent evaluation within tolerance on every compared input. checked-convention: run; values differ on some inputs because of a documented convention. checked-defect: run; values are wrong under the published definition. checked-no-value: run; the tool returns no value or an error on the compared inputs.
